title: Serum Before or After Night Cream? How to Layer Them
ex: Serum goes before night cream. Learn the full night order, how long to wait, when the rule changes, and how to stop products pilling in humid weather.
rt: Serum Before or After Night Cream? | Mirc Glow
rd: Serum before or after night cream? Before. Learn the right night order, how long to wait between layers, good pairings, and mistakes that cause pilling.
keyword: serum before or after night cream
quick: Serum goes before night cream. Apply thinnest to thickest: a watery serum on clean skin first, then the night cream on top to hold it in. Wait until the serum no longer feels wet, usually under a minute. Face oils go last, after the cream.
facts: The general rule is thinnest to thickest.
Waiting 30–60 seconds between layers is usually enough.
Too much product or heavy rubbing often causes pilling.
Keep to one active serum per night.
